Every listed input has an actual role: H001 gives primality and the parameter interval; H002 gives dimension and commutator/representation identities; H004 gives the simultaneous lattice basis and U_Z-stability; N001 gives |I|=n, the complex basis e and divided-power action formulas. These uses are genuine even if another route could avoid some input. Eight positively checked background notes account for the routine omitted prime-product, basis-finiteness/reindexing, tensor universal-property/generation and basis-map facts. No localization, lattice-classification, irreducibility or matrix-unit theorem is silently imported: the relevant injectivity, Lie action and operator identities are proved in S001–S005. The characteristic-p clause of H001 and irreducibility/highest-weight descriptions in H002 are not needed for this local inference; no wholly unused H input is removed or assigned an invented role.
